source_provenance.terms_caveat: Sina ETF/fund history is used only after the Eastmoney fund endpoint exhausts its bounded retry. Prices are provider-reported raw (the endpoint has no adjustment parameter). Sina reports volume in shares and amount in CNY; reconciling amount/(volume*close) over 2 rows gives a median of 0.996368 -> shares_cny. Volume is normalized by dividing reported shares by 100 to the governed CN ETF lot basis (raw shares / governed lots = 100:1); amount remains provider-reported CNY. The refresh validates the normalized lots against the sealed governed overlap at 0.001 relative tolerance and fails closed on drift.
